machine.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 with Radeon 890M

profile: One fresh isolated CODEV_DATA_ROOT reused for five sequential launches.

method.startup: Elapsed time from Start-Process invocation until the process exposes a nonzero MainWindowHandle.
method.idleSampling: 16 private-byte and working-set samples at 500 ms intervals after the window handle appears.
method.workload: No project opened and no model request sent.

limitations: Warm-filesystem samples from one Windows machine; this does not measure cold-machine startup.
Main-window handle is a startup proxy, not proof of first rendered frame or user-visible readiness.
Idle-only sampling does not establish memory with a long conversation or large project open.
No time-to-first-token measurement was made, and Ollama/model process memory is excluded.
These observations inform a future performance budget but do not set one.
